checks.stdout:
Inspect provider-neutral gateway interactions.

Use the replay subcommand to stream normalized PNIG fixture events as one JSON object per line without provider credentials or live network calls.

Usage:
  yui interaction [flags]
  yui interaction [command]

Examples:
  yui interaction replay ./fixtures/example.interaction.json

Available Commands:
  replay      Replay a normalized interaction fixture as NDJSON

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for interaction

Global Flags:
      --allow-path stringArray   Additional filesystem-tool root (repeatable; relative to --workdir)
  -C, --config-dir string        Directory for agent CLI config (default: ~/.agent-cli)
      --log-to-stdout            Log to stdout/stderr instead of file (default: logs to file in config directory)
  -v, --verbose count            Enable verbose output (use -v for info, -vv for debug)
      --workdir string           Filesystem-tool workdir (default: the process current directory)

Use "yui interaction [command] --help" for more information about a command.
